rules.shots: shots tile every section in theme order; each shot is 1-4 whole bars, so every cut lands on a downbeat; the last outro shot is >= 2 bars (end card)
rules.captions: one short caption per shot saying what the picture shows, bound to verified claim ids; CJK <= 16 characters per line, other scripts <= 9 words / 42 characters per line, <= 2 lines; readable in the shot (CJK 7 chars/s, others 3.3 words/s)
rules.keywords: caption.em lists the 1-2 key words to highlight (each must occur in the caption text)
rules.fact_lines: kind "fact" binds >= 1 claim; rejected claims are never bound; prefer verified claims
rules.single_source: hedge "attributed" + an attribution phrase (zh 据记载/相传, en according to/records say); <= 2 shots; never in intro or drops
rules.numbers: every date or number in any text (title, captions, cards, end card) must be in the bound claims
rules.names: place, person and work names of any claim appear only in captions bound to that claim
rules.rehooks: each plan.rehooks[i] needs a shot with rehook: true starting within 1 bar of it (gaps <= 35 s)
rules.knowledge_points: plan.kp.min-max cards; each kp is shown by exactly one shot (>= 2 bars) in verse/build/drop/breakdown/build2/drop2; card.value equals a claim value; count = number to count up to
rules.sfx: annotate every key action of the scene (element appears, number counts, seal, route draws, reveal) with { beat, kind, tier }; transitions, drops, cards, title and end card get automatic cues
rules.portraits: never draw a realistic face; living people are never depicted (params.depicts_person)
